display.title: Erev Shavuos: We Were All at Har Sinai
display.summary_short: On Erev Shavuos, Uncle Yossi explains that every Jewish soul stood at Har Sinai, so tomorrow in shul we relive hearing the Ten Commandments.
display.summary_long: An Erev Shavuos talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given less than two hours before the Yom Tov candles. Uncle Yossi explains that Shavuos is when we relive standing at Har Sinai. When the Ten Commandments are read in shul tomorrow, we picture ourselves hearing Hashem's voice. The Chumash says Hashem spoke these words 'leimor', so that we would repeat them and teach them to our children for all generations. In the year 2448, not only the Jews alive then but the souls of every future generation were at Har Sinai, so every child listening was there too and called out 'Naaseh v'nishma'. Hashem then gave us the strength to learn and keep the Torah. Children are asked to find out when the Ten Commandments will be read in their shul, to come on time, and, like proud soldiers of Tzivos Hashem, to share this with everyone in the family, from the youngest to the oldest.
display.lesson: Every one of us stood at Har Sinai; come to shul on Shavuos to hear the Ten Commandments and bring the whole family.

date.note: 'In less than two hours from now' the Yom Tov candles of Shavuos: Erev Shavuos 5750, Tuesday 29 May 1990.

sources_cited.note: 'And Hashem spoke all these words, saying (leimor)': to teach them to future generations.
